exposure: Babies with NICU stay less than 7 days
Babies with NICU stay more than 30 days
cohort: 240 high-risk newborns admitted to the NICU for more than 48 hours, of whom 200 were followed up at 2 years of age.
finding: At 2 years of age, 17.5% of babies had behavioral issues, 12% had withdrawal, 16% had aggressiveness, 20% had features of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, and 2% had features related to autism.
mod_finding: 52% of the babies were born via normal vaginal delivery, 44% were born via cesarean section, and 2% were assisted deliveries.
birth_weight: Not specified (low birth weight defined as <2500 grams)
